title: Annular liquid jets: solvers and data for exact constraint absorption and finite-time loss of transversality
description: Chebyshev collocation solvers for the one-dimensional model of annular liquid jets in which the algebraic constraint at the free end is absorbed identically, an independent third-order upwind finite-difference solver used for cross-validation, the drivers that regenerate every table and figure of the accompanying paper, and the resulting data.
notes: Supported by the Universidad de Malaga through project PPRO-B4-2026-004 of its Plan Propio de Investigacion, Transferencia y Divulgacion Cientifica. Computations used resources of the Supercomputing and Bioinformatics Center (SCBI) of the Universidad de Malaga.
